title: Clinical Practice Guidelines — How They Are Made, AGREE II and Using Them Well

hook.en: A guideline can save you hours of searching, or lead you confidently in the wrong direction. Some are built from careful reviews by independent panels; others are opinions in a nice cover. Learn how guidelines are made, how to judge one in minutes, and how to use it without turning into a robot.
hook.ur: Guideline aap ke ghanton ki search bacha sakti hai, ya aap ko itminan se ghalat rukh mein le ja sakti hai. Kuch azaad panels ke ehtiyat se kiye gaye reviews se banti hain; doosri khoobsurat cover mein raye hoti hain. Seekhein guidelines kaise banti hain, ek ko chand minute mein kaise parkhein, aur robot bane baghair kaise istemal karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll describe how a trustworthy guideline is developed, use the six domains of AGREE II to judge quality, read strength of recommendation and certainty of evidence, and adapt a guideline to your patient.
goal.ur: End tak aap bharosemand guideline ki tayyari bayan karenge, quality parakhne ke liye AGREE II ke chhe domains istemal karenge, sifarish ki mazbooti aur saboot ki yaqeeniyat parhenge, aur guideline ko apne mareez ke mutabiq dhalenge.

text.en: A **clinical practice guideline** is a set of recommendations, based on a systematic review of the evidence and a weighing of benefits and harms, to help clinicians and patients decide about care. A trustworthy guideline is made by a **multidisciplinary panel** (including patients), manages **conflicts of interest**, uses **systematic reviews**, rates the **certainty of evidence** and the **strength of each recommendation** (for example with GRADE), is externally reviewed and has a plan for **updating**. **AGREE II** is a 23-item tool, in six domains, to appraise a guideline's quality.
text.ur: **Clinical practice guideline** sifarishat ka set hai, jo saboot ke systematic review aur faide aur nuqsan ke tolne par mabni hai, taake clinicians aur mareez care ka faisla kar saken. Bharosemand guideline **multidisciplinary panel** (mareez samet) banata hai, **mufaadat ke takrao** sambhalta hai, **systematic reviews** istemal karta hai, **saboot ki yaqeeniyat** aur **har sifarish ki mazbooti** (masalan GRADE se) rate karta hai, bairooni jaiza leta hai aur **update** ka plan rakhta hai. **AGREE II** 23 items ka, chhe domains mein, aala hai jo guideline ki quality parakhta hai.

text.en: Think of **a recipe from a famous restaurant** versus **a recipe from a stranger's blog**. The famous one has been tested by many cooks, written by professionals and updated when ingredients change. The blog might be great or terrible, and you cannot tell. AGREE II is the quick test to see whether a guideline has been "tested in the kitchen".
text.ur: **Mashhoor restaurant ki recipe** aur **ajnabi ke blog ki recipe** sochein. Mashhoor wali kai bawarchiyon ne aazmayi, peshawar logon ne likhi aur ajzaa badalne par update ki gayi hoti hai. Blog behtareen ya bura ho sakta hai, aur aap farq nahi bata sakte. AGREE II tez test hai jo dekhta hai guideline "kitchen mein aazmayi" gayi hai ya nahi.

rows.en: Are the objectives, the questions and the patients clearly described?
rows.ur: Kya maqasid, sawal aur mareez saaf bayan hain?

rows.en: A specific clinical question and a defined population
rows.ur: Khaas clinical sawal aur tay shuda aabadi

rows.en: Were all relevant professionals and patients involved?
rows.ur: Kya tamam mutaliq peshawar aur mareez shamil thay?

rows.en: A panel with several disciplines and patient representatives
rows.ur: Kai shobon aur mareezon ke numainday wala panel

rows.en: Were the evidence searches, selection methods and links to recommendations systematic?
rows.ur: Kya saboot ki search, intikhab ke tareeqe aur sifarishon se rabt systematic thay?

rows.en: A systematic review, explicit methods and external review
rows.ur: Systematic review, saaf tareeqe aur bairooni jaiza

rows.en: Are the recommendations specific, unambiguous and easy to find?
rows.ur: Kya sifarishat khaas, saaf aur aasani se milne wali hain?

rows.en: Key recommendations summarised, options clearly stated
rows.ur: Ahem sifarishat ka khulasa, options saaf bayan

rows.en: Are barriers, tools, resource implications and audit criteria discussed?
rows.ur: Kya rukawatein, aale, wasail ke asraat aur audit criteria zer-e-bahas hain?
Amal ke aale aur nigrani ke mashware

rows.en: Was funding separate from content, and were conflicts of interest recorded?
rows.ur: Kya funding mawad se alag thi, aur mufaadat ke takrao darj hue?

rows.en: Declared interests and a funder with no say in the recommendations
rows.ur: Batayey gaye mufaadat aur funder jis ka sifarishat mein koi ikhtiyar nahi

question.en: A guideline on back pain was written by five clinicians who sell a particular device, with no systematic search and no declared interests. Which AGREE II domains are weakest?
question.ur: Peeth dard par guideline paanch clinicians ne likhi jo ek khaas aala bechte hain, bina systematic search aur bina bataye gaye mufaadat ke. AGREE II ke kaun se domains sab se kamzor hain?

text.en: Rigour of development and editorial independence
text.ur: Tayyari ki sakhti aur idariyati azaadi

feedback.en: Yes — no systematic evidence search and undeclared interests undermine trust.
feedback.ur: Haan — systematic saboot search ka na hona aur na bataye gaye mufaadat bharosa kamzor karte hain.

feedback.en: The problems lie in how it was made.
feedback.ur: Masail is mein hain ke kaise bani.

question.en: A guideline says "strong recommendation, low certainty evidence". How would you read it?
question.ur: Guideline kehti hai "mazboot sifarish, kam yaqeeniyat ka saboot". Ise kaise parhein?

feedback.en: Low certainty means it could change.
feedback.ur: Kam yaqeeniyat ka matlab hai badal sakti hai.

text.en: The panel judges that the benefits clearly outweigh harms for most patients, even though the evidence is not very certain; check for the reasons and for patient preferences
text.ur: Panel samajhta hai ke zyada tar mareezon ke liye faide nuqsan se saaf zyada hain, chahe saboot bohat yaqeeni nahi; wajuhaat aur mareez ki pasand dekhein

feedback.en: Yes — strength and certainty are different things.
feedback.ur: Haan — mazbooti aur yaqeeniyat mukhtalif cheezein hain.

text.ur: Sifarish nazar-andaaz ki ja sakti hai

feedback.ur: Mazboot sifarish tawajjo ki mustahiq hai.

question.en: A guideline recommends a programme of 3 sessions per week for 12 weeks, but your patient works two jobs and lives far from the clinic. What is the best use of the guideline?
question.ur: Guideline 12 haftay tak haftay mein 3 sessions ki programme tajweez karti hai, lekin aap ka mareez do naukriyan karta hai aur clinic se door rehta hai. Guideline ka behtareen istemal kya hai?

text.en: Insist on exactly 3 sessions, or no care at all
text.ur: Bilkul 3 sessions par zid karein, warna koi care nahi

feedback.ur: Yeh mareez ki zindagi nazar-andaaz karta hai.
Is mein phir bhi qeemti saboot hai.

text.en: Use it as a guide, discuss options with the patient, and adapt the plan (for example a home version) while keeping the main principles
text.ur: Isay rehnumai ke taur par istemal karein, mareez se options par baat karein, aur bunyadi usoolon ko qaim rakhte hue plan ko dhalein (masalan ghar ka version)

feedback.en: Yes — guidelines inform, they do not replace judgement and patient values.
feedback.ur: Haan — guidelines rehnumai karti hain, judgement aur mareez ki values ki jagah nahi leti.

text.en: **Following a guideline blindly, or dismissing it because it is "cookbook medicine".** Guidelines summarise evidence for average patients; they cannot know your patient's job, fears or other conditions. Equally, ignoring a well-made guideline in favour of habit wastes the work of many experts. Check the date (old guidelines miss new evidence), the country (resources differ) and whether it fits your patient's age and comorbidities.
text.ur: **Guideline ko aankhein band kar ke follow karna, ya "recipe wali tibb" keh kar radd karna.** Guidelines average mareezon ke liye saboot ka khulasa karti hain; woh aap ke mareez ka kaam, khauf ya doosri bimariyan nahi jaan sakti. Isi tarah achhi tarah bani guideline ko aadat ke haq mein nazar-andaaz karna bohat se maahireen ki mehnat zaya karna hai. Tareekh (purani guidelines naye saboot chhod deti hain), mulk (wasail mukhtalif hain) aur yeh dekhein ke kya aap ke mareez ki umar aur saath ki bimariyon ke mutabiq hai.

text.en: **Find and check one guideline in ten minutes.** Search the guideline databases or the websites of professional societies for your condition, note the year and the developers, scan the summary of recommendations and the reference to a systematic review, and check conflicts of interest. Print a one-page summary for the clinic and mark what you will do differently.
text.ur: **Das minute mein ek guideline dhoondhein aur jaanchein.** Apni bimari ke liye guideline databases ya peshawarana anjumanon ki websites mein search karein, saal aur tayyar karne walon ko note karein, sifarishat ka khulasa aur systematic review ka hawala dekhein, aur mufaadat ke takrao jaanchein. Clinic ke liye ek safha ka khulasa print karein aur nishan lagayein ke aap kya mukhtalif karenge.

question.en: Why do guidelines on the same condition sometimes disagree?
question.ur: Ek hi bimari par guidelines kabhi mukhtalif kyun hoti hain?

answer.en: They may use different searches or dates, weigh harms and costs differently, serve different health systems, or involve panels with different views and interests. When two guidelines disagree, look at their methods and conflicts of interest, check the dates and the strength of evidence behind each, and prefer the one with better rigour that fits your setting.
answer.ur: Woh mukhtalif search ya tareekhein istemal kar sakti hain, nuqsan aur kharch ko mukhtalif tarah tolti hain, mukhtalif nizam-e-sehat ki khidmat karti hain, ya aise panels shamil karti hain jin ke nuqta-e-nazar aur mufaadat mukhtalif hon. Jab do guidelines mukhtalif hon to un ke tareeqe aur mufaadat ke takrao dekhein, tareekhein aur har ek ke peechay saboot ki mazbooti jaanchein, aur behtar sakhti wali ko tarjeeh dein jo aap ke halaat se milti ho.

beats.patient: A physiotherapist finds two guidelines on knee osteoarthritis. One, from an international panel, used a systematic review and graded evidence, recommending exercise and education first. The other, from a company-sponsored meeting, recommends a device.
beats.assessment: The first has rigour and independence; the second has a sponsor with a stake.
beats.treatment: She follows the first, uses exercise and education as core care, and tells her patient the device has not been shown to add much beyond them.
beats.reassess: The patient improves with the exercise programme and avoids an expensive purchase.

text.en: **Guidelines do not override safety.** A guideline may not cover your patient's red flags, medicines or other conditions. If the person in front of you is outside its scope, such as a frail elder with several illnesses, use judgement and seek advice. Be especially careful with old guidelines on medicines and procedures where new safety information may have appeared.
text.ur: **Guidelines safety ko override nahi karti.** Guideline aap ke mareez ke red flags, dawaiyan ya doosri bimariyan cover na kare to bhi. Agar saamne mareez uske daire se bahar ho, jaise kai bimariyon wala kamzor buzurg, to judgement istemal karein aur mashwara lein. Dawaiyon aur procedures ki purani guidelines ke saath khaas ehtiyat karein jahan naye safety maloomat aa sakte hain.

text.en: The AGREE II instrument, developed by an international collaboration, comprises 23 items across six domains and a global rating, and is widely used to appraise the quality of practice guidelines. The Institute of Medicine's report on trustworthy guidelines set eight standards, including managing conflicts of interest, a multidisciplinary panel with patient involvement, a systematic review of the evidence, clear rating of evidence and recommendation strength, external review and updating when new evidence arrives.
text.ur: AGREE II aala, jo beinul-aqwami taawun se bana, chhe domains mein 23 items aur ek kul rating rakhta hai, aur practice guidelines ki quality parakhne ke liye wasi taur par istemal hota hai. Institute of Medicine ki bharosemand guidelines par report ne aath mayar tay kiye, jin mein mufaadat ke takrao ka intizam, mareez ki shirkat wala multidisciplinary panel, saboot ka systematic review, saboot aur sifarish ki mazbooti ki saaf rating, bairooni jaiza aur naya saboot aane par update shamil hain.

text.en: **Panel, Review, Grade, Declare, Date.** Who made it, what evidence, how graded, interests declared, and how recent?
text.ur: **Panel, Review, Grade, Elaan, Tareekh.** Kis ne banai, kaun sa saboot, kaise grade hua, mufaadat ka elaan, aur kitni taaza?

summary.en: Trustworthy guidelines use a multidisciplinary panel, systematic reviews, graded evidence, declared interests and updating.
summary.ur: Bharosemand guidelines multidisciplinary panel, systematic reviews, grade shuda saboot, bataye gaye mufaadat aur update istemal karti hain.

summary.en: AGREE II judges quality across six domains; strength of a recommendation and certainty of evidence are different.
summary.ur: AGREE II chhe domains mein quality parakhta hai; sifarish ki mazbooti aur saboot ki yaqeeniyat mukhtalif hain.

summary.en: Use guidelines as a guide, adapt them to the patient, and never let them override safety or judgement.
summary.ur: Guidelines ko rehnumai ke taur par istemal karein, mareez ke mutabiq dhalein, aur unhein safety ya judgement par haavi na hone dein.

back.en: A 23-item tool, in six domains, to judge the quality of a guideline.
back.ur: Chhe domains mein 23 items ka aala jo guideline ki quality parakhta hai.

back.en: Strength is how firmly to act; certainty is how sure we are of the evidence.
back.ur: Mazbooti yeh hai ke kitne yaqeen se amal karein; yaqeeniyat yeh hai ke saboot par hum kitne yaqeeni hain.

back.en: Old guidelines may miss new evidence.
back.ur: Purani guidelines naya saboot chhod sakti hain.

front.en: Name a sign of a weak guideline.
front.ur: Kamzor guideline ki ek nishani batayein.

back.en: No systematic evidence search, or undeclared conflicts of interest.
back.ur: Systematic saboot search nahi, ya na bataye gaye mufaadat ke takrao.

note.en: Getting a guideline used in practice.
